issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 06 requests the names and the inhabitant counts (Einwohnerzahlen) of all municipalities with >100,000 male and >100,000 female inhabitants, but the reference solution returns only the municipality name. This mismatch between the expected columns (name plus numeric Einwohnerzahlen) and the solution's SELECT clause can confuse students about the required output and grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution to return the requested columns. For example, change the reference query to: SELECT name, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000; Alternatively, adjust the problem text to request only the municipality names if that was the intended requirement.
